title: How Apollo 11 almost aborted (Dagar Unfiltered style demo)

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: This is one of the most famous photos of all time.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Two men are dropping toward the Moon in a fragile little lander called Eagle.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Then the computer throws an alarm.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Nobody in the cockpit knows what it means.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Down in Houston, the call falls on a 26-year-old named Steve Bales.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Next to him sits a 24-year-old engineer, Jack Garman, with a handwritten list of every alarm the computer can throw.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: His answer? It's an overload. If it doesn't keep happening, we're fine.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Meanwhile Armstrong looks out the window and sees the computer is flying them straight into a field of boulders.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Houston starts calling out the fuel.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The most famous moment of the century came down to a young engineer and a list he wrote by hand.
